description: Source code for Windows proxy configuration service in Chromium project, handling registry monitoring and proxy settings retrieval.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Windows-specific proxy configuration service handling registry change notifications and proxy retrieval.

methods.name: FreeIEConfig
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for IE proxy configuration strings.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::ProxyConfigServiceWin
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy config service and adding network change observer.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::~ProxyConfigServiceWin
methods.description: Destructor removing network change observer and clearing registry watch list.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer and starts registry watching.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::OnNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change events, triggers proxy config recheck if connection is none.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::StartWatchingRegistryForChanges
methods.description: Initializes registry keys to watch for proxy setting changes.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::AddKeyToWatchList
methods.description: Adds a registry key to the watch list for change notifications.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Handles registry change notifications, triggers recheck of proxy settings.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::GetCurrentProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current proxy configuration from Windows IE proxy settings.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin::SetFromIEConfig
methods.description: Parses IE proxy config and sets corresponding proxy configuration.
